How to Use This Map
🎯 Check Your Location:

1. Click "My Location" to share your GPS location.
2. The map will show whether your location falls inside the mapped inundation area.
3. View the historical flood-depth category.

🔍 Search a Place:

Type the name of a place, shop, temple, school, hospital, railway station, public building, tourist attraction, market, or other mapped facility.

For example:
• Temple of the Tooth
• Gampola Railway Station
• Peradeniya Hospital
• school name
• shop name

📊 Understanding Flood Depth:
  • High: Water depth > 3 meters
  • Moderate: Water depth 1.5–3 meters
  • Low: Water depth < 1.5 meters
⚠️ Important:

This map shows PAST flood inundation from the Ditwah event only. It does NOT predict future floods.

Place search uses OpenStreetMap data through the Photon search service.
